name: PAYONE Payments
description: Not offered. The PAYONE APIs need per-request HMAC signatures or have no read endpoint for transactions, so this adapter cannot work; kept only so connectors installed earlier still resolve.
instructions:
**Not offered: this adapter cannot work and is kept only so connectors installed earlier still resolve.**

It was written against `payment.payone.com` (the PAYONE / Worldline Direct API). That API does not accept a static key in a header: every request must carry a GCS v1HMAC signature computed over the method, content type, an RFC 1123 `Date` and the path, which this connector cannot produce. It also has no endpoint that lists transactions, so `payone_list_transactions` has nothing to call.

The classic PAYONE Server API (`https://api.pay1.de/post-gateway/`) was checked as an alternative. It has no request that lists or looks up transactions either: transaction status reaches the merchant only as a push (TransactionStatus notification) to a URL the shop runs. Its read requests are the invoice and mandate PDFs (`getinvoice`, `getfile`), the stored customer record (`getuser`, including bank details) and checks such as `addresscheck` and `consumerscore`, which are billed per call. None of these gives an agent a useful, safe view of payments, so no replacement is offered.

Capture and refund were removed from this adapter: money-moving calls are never shipped unless they can be verified end to end.

**What to use instead**: read payment data in the PAYONE Merchant Interface (PMI), or export it from there into a system this workspace already connects to.
